newsitem.title: USA: House intelligence committee chairman appointed.
newsitem.headline: House intelligence committee chairman appointed.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich on Monday appointed Representative Porter Goss, a former CIA agent, to be chairman of the House Intelligence Committee.

"His unique experience as a former CIA Clandestine Services officer and his service during the past two years on the committee make him a natural choice for the position," Gingrich said in a statement.
Goss, 58, a Florida Republican, was a Central Intelligence Agency operative from 1962 to 1972. He then went into city and county politics in Florida and has been in Congress since 1988.
